summary: The 8-K reports the results of Central Bancompany's 2026 Annual Meeting (Item 5.07), including the election of four directors, ratification of KPMG as auditor, and adoption of the 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Additionally, Item 8.01 announces a $0.12 per share quarterly dividend declared on May 4, 2026, payable June 1, 2026. These are routine governance and capital-return matters; no merger, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report of shareholder votes and a dividend declaration, not a special-situation event.
